brief:
An Israeli airstrike on a port facility west of Gaza City killed at least seven people, including a child, and left dozens wounded, Middle East Eye reported. The bombing occurred Tuesday afternoon, targeting the port infrastructure along Gaza's western coast.

The strike drew civilians and workers to the area, who sustained injuries ranging from minor to severe. Rescue and medical personnel responded to assist the wounded, though the full scope of structural damage to the port remained unclear in the immediate aftermath of the attack.

title: Israeli strike on Gaza port kills seven, including child
